description.tr: Fâtımî döneminin en önemli Mısırlı hekimi — klinik gözlemleri ortaçağ Kahire'sinin başlıca tıbbi kaydını sunar || İbn Rıdvân otodidakttı — tıp eğitimi alamadı ve kitaplardan öğrendi. || [Tarih notu] 1065 Mısır kıtlığına dair anlatımı, ortaçağ döneminin en ayrıntılı epidemiyolojik betimlemelerinden biridir.
description.en: Most important Egyptian physician of the Fatimid era — his clinical observations and epidemiological writings provide the primary medical record of medieval Cairo || Ibn Ridwan was self-taught — he couldn't afford a medical education and learned from books. His debate with Ibn Butlan on the value of practical vs. textual learning is a classic of Islamic medical literature. || [Historiographical note] His account of the 1065 famine in Egypt is one of the most detailed epidemiological descriptions from the medieval period.
description.ar: أهم طبيب مصري في العصر الفاطمي || كان ابن رضوان عصامياً — لم يستطع تحمل تكاليف التعليم الطبي فتعلم من الكتب
